data.title: No Buy Year Planner 2027 Printable, Low Buy Year Tracker, No Spend Challenge Calendar, Shopping Ban Tracker, 30 Day Want List PDF
data.description:
Start 2027 with a no-buy or low-buy year you can actually keep: write your rules once, tick off every no-spend day, and park impulse wants on a 30-day list until they fade. Made for anyone pausing shopping in clothes, decor, beauty or takeout to save money in the new year.

What's inside (13 pages):
- How to Use page with a first-week plan and ideas for your stop-buying list
- My No-Buy Rules: I stop buying, still allowed (and my limit), planned buys, use it up first, my why, my reward
- 30-Day Want List with a wait-until date and a decision column
- Temptation Log to spot what triggers spending
- 12 dated No-Spend Calendars, January to December 2027, with a tick circle on every day and monthly no-spend days and money-kept totals
- 2027 Year Tally for each month's totals and a year total
- Monthly Check-In and Year-End Review prompts

How it works:
This is a digital PDF download. Nothing ships. After purchase, download the file from your Etsy Purchases page or the email Etsy sends you, then print at home or at any print shop. Prints on US Letter and fits A4 with "fit to page". You can also open it in any tablet PDF app that lets you write on pages. For personal use.

This design was created with AI assistance under the creative direction of the seller.
